in_sanskrit.name: Kishansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Earth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kishansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Kishansh is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Kishan' meaning 'Lord' and 'Sh' meaning 'Earth'. This name is associated with the deity Vishnu, who is often depicted as the preserver of the universe and the nurturer of all beings. The name Kishansh is believed to bestow upon its bearer the virtues of strength, nurturing qualities, and the ability to preserve and protect.
